stations.name: Noir FM 91.3
chatter: You're riding the night with Noir FM. Keep it smooth.
That rain on your windshield? That's just the city crying. Next track.
Word on the wire: Halcyon's shipping something big through Berth 7. We don't ask questions. Neither should you.
A shout-out to the cab drivers still working the Furnace. You know who you are.
Syndicate money, family money — it all spends the same at Ruth's. Back to the music.

stations.name: Static 88
stations.tag: the sound of the slag line
chatter: Eyewitnesses say a body turned up near the docks last night. Cops are calling it 'an ongoing matter.' We call it Tuesday.
Reminder: the city wants you calm, medicated, and indoors. Stay loud.
Caller on line three says she saw drones over Crown Heights. Caller, we believe you.
Halcyon Pharmaceuticals would like to remind you that compliance is a lifestyle.

stations.name: Furnace Classic
chatter: Furnace Classic — the songs your grandfather welded to.
Union Local 9 wants you to know: the picket line at the Slagworks is open, and so is the coffee.
This next one's for everybody working second shift. You built this city. Don't let them forget it.
Weather's turning. Keep your windows up and your radio warm.
And that was a deep cut from '32. They don't press them like that anymore.
